facts.fact: The e-Vital Togo pilot covers four communes (Golfe 3, Agoe-Nyive 1, Kozah 1, Bassar 1), where facilities send births and deaths electronically to civil-status offices that verify, print and sign the act.
Togoscoop reports the one-year e-Vital Togo project is financed by Vital Strategies under project GGP 166.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, funded by Vital Strategies
